11.t: Committees The Shire of Mt Marshall has two standing committees: The Mt Marshall Audit Committee as required by the Local Government Act; and the Local Emergency Management Committee as required by the Emergency Management Act The Council has formally resolved to establish the following committees and working groups: Mt Marshall Safety Committee; Bush Fire Advisory Committee; Economic Development Grant Fund Committee; Facilities and Services Committee, Off Road Racing Working Group

Thank you to all community members who have sat on and contributed to Council Committees during the year The Local Emergency Management Committee (LEMC) which has been well attended by all agencies has continued with planning, compliance and addressing emergency management in the Shire

Notable projects included the Monger Street redevelopment in Bencubbin, the Beacon Community Park including a gazebo, barbeque, lawn garden, paving and native play area, new double cabins at each of the caravan parks plus a camp kitchen facility and five more powered sites at the Beacon Caravan Park This also involved upgraded power and water infrastructure

Committees The Shire of Mt Marshall has two standing committees: The Mt Marshall Audit Committee as required by the Local Government Act; and the Local Emergency Management Committee as required by the Emergency Management Act The Council has formally resolved to establish the following committees and working groups: Bush Fire Advisory Committee; Economic Development Advisory Committee; Facilities and Services Committee, Off Road Racing Working Group

Other projects carried over from 2022/23 included new double cabins at each of the caravan parks plus a camp kitchen facility and five more powered sites at the Beacon Caravan Park with upgraded power and water infrastructure

So 100 years on, the Shire of Mt Marshall Centenary was commemorated on Saturday, 23rd September 2023 After a dignitary’s event in the Council chambers in the afternoon, residents both past and present met in a paddock with a large marquee and stage with associated lighting, welcome packs, children’s entertainment with Perth’s Bouncy Castle including mini golf and a “bucking bronco”, food from WA Spit Roast, beverages from Raunchy Brewing Company, and live music from the Little Lord Street Band The evening included a production of “The Way We Were” by Beacon Theatre Arts

3.t: Of note is the importance of support for the Kununoppin Hospital Auxiliary which now concentrate their fund raising at the show The WA Off Road Racing Association Event again attracted a huge influx of people into the Shire over the WA long weekend in June The monthly community breakfasts alternating between Beacon and Bencubbin have continued These events along with various smaller events held, contribute to the enjoyment and well-being of everyone living here in Mt Marshall The year also saw the first full twelve months with Western Australia Country Health Service running the health centres in Beacon and Bencubbin This transistion has involved changes in terms of personnel and equipment and seems to be going well The Shire has continued its support for the supply of medical services

In 1889 Surveyor HS King fixed Trigg Station at Mt Marshall When the Wyalkatchem-Mt Marshall Railway Line was built, the siding was not named as there was already a Mt Marshall in Tasmania
